product_metadata.title: Utopia Bedding King Cal Sheet Set, Soft Microfiber 4 Piece Bed Sheets with 16" Deep Pocket - Easy Care Brushed Microfiber (Quatrefoil - Navy)
features: BRUSHED MICROFIBER – Woven from brushed microfiber fabric, the bed sheets are iron easy, wrinkle free, fade resistant and protects against any shrinkage after washing. The sheet set adds a layer of comfort to your bedding while enhancing your sleeping experience to the fullest.
QUATREFOIL PATTERN - Add a trendy & timeless flair to your bedroom with quatrefoil patterned bedsheets. The pattern is ideal for residential, hospitality, and assisted living environments.

FINEST CRAFTSMANSHIP – Breathable, cool and smooth printed sheets are designed to enhance the look of your bedroom. Our fitted sheets have all-around elastic and deep pockets while the pillowcases contain envelope closure to keep the pillows secure.
WASHING INSTRUCTIONS – It is recommended to wash the sheets set with similar colored items for best results. Avoid washing the sheets with dark colored items
CARE INSTRUCTIONS - Machine wash, tumble dry or iron on low temperature; do not bleach

details.Special Feature: Fade Resistant, Deep Pocket, Shrink Resistant
